essence: Dispossession (nothing mine, 1) → begging that begs (2) → straw thrones, sterile merit (3) → unblocked praise (4) → even in dream (5) → fragrance-dot transfiguring (6) → one work only (7) → resume of disqualifications (8) → trifles to pearls (9) → even cheating devotion works (10) → litany as battering-ram (11) → cornered metaphysics, clinging while harassed (12) → approved suffering, chosen longevity (13) → skilled destroyer, act now (14) → bow to the sole work and over-bright light (15).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of longing (utsuka); the vyabhicāri is trust (viśvasita) that keeps begging from despair. The rasa is the tranquility of longing-trust — dispossession plus longing plus trust as a complete path. The title names it: Autsukyaviśvasita (Yearning and assurance). Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as śānta: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute as sole object of longing, with trust as the stabilizing vyabhicāri.
